d: Why does every Pakistan cricket conversation seem to come back to Babar Azam? During the ongoing Pakistan vs Sri Lanka Test series, Mike Hesson finally lost patience with repeated questions about the former Pakistan captain's form. But the reality is that Babar has not scored a Test century since December 2022. At the same time, Pakistan's cricket team has other players making important contributions, and their performances deserve attention too. Rupha Ramani looks at Pakistan cricket's Babar Azam obsession, Hesson's reaction and the questions that still need honest answers.
